title: Line chart
description: Lines or filled areas over numbers, dates or categories. Handles millions of points on the GPU.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Two series over a category axis; the tooltip shows every series at the hovered x.

area.title: Area
area.description: area fills the space under the lines; the series opacity sets the fill.

curves.title: Curves
curves.description: curve sets the shape between the points: linear joins them with straight segments, smooth draws a monotone curve that never overshoots the data, step holds each value until the next point. A series can set its own curve.

stacked.title: Stacked
stacked.description: stacked piles the series so the top line is the total, and percent turns the stacks into shares of 100%. A y axis format replaces the percent ticks, so it is only set for amounts.

time-series.title: Time series
time-series.description: Date x values switch to a time axis; Intl.DateTimeFormat and Intl.NumberFormat write the dates and the compact y ticks in the reader's language.

large-data.title: 1,000,000 points
large-data.description: Typed-array columns with sorted timestamps: only the visible range is drawn. Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel to zoom.

traffic-events.title: Traffic with events
traffic-events.description: Daily visitors with a dashed x line for a product launch and a shaded area for an outage: annotations take the same timestamps as the data.

gaps.title: Missing data
gaps.description: A null y value leaves a gap instead of drawing a misleading line through the missing readings.

thresholds.title: Thresholds
thresholds.description: Server latency percentiles with a dashed y line for the objective and a red area above the critical level, so breaches stand out at a glance.

zoom.title: Range selector
zoom.description: Period buttons call setView on the chart ref with the visible window and a y range fitted to the prices inside it; Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and drag still work.

data.visitorsAria: Visitors per day, this week and last week
data.temperatureAria: Average monthly temperatures in Lisbon and Oslo
data.spendAria: Monthly cloud spend by service, stacked
data.trafficAria: Daily page views and sessions, first half of 2026
data.largeStatus: {{points}} points · drawn with {{renderer}} · Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel to zoom, drag to pan, double-click to reset
data.eventsAria: Daily visitors over 90 days with a product launch and an outage
data.gapsAria: Hourly indoor and outdoor temperatures with missing readings
data.gapsNote: The sensors were offline for a few hours: the line stops instead of guessing.
data.latencyAria: API latency over six hours, median and 95th percentile
data.priceAria: Daily closing price over two years
data.usageAria: CPU and memory usage over the day
data.pinchHint: Pinch to zoom, double tap to reset; tap the legend to hide a series.

LineChartProps.series: Series drawn as lines (or areas) unless they set a type
LineChartProps.area: Fills the area under the lines
LineChartProps.stacked: Stacks the series on top of each other
LineChartProps.percent: Scales the stacks to 100% at each x (with stacked)

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Drag a finger along the line to scrub it; onHover reports the highlighted day.

area.title: Area
area.description: area fills under the lines; pinch to zoom, double tap to reset, tap the legend to hide a series.

trend.title: Weekly trend
trend.description: Two smooth lines on category axes; the series names and days follow the page language.

reset-zoom.title: Zoom and reset
reset-zoom.description: 2,000 points: Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel or pinch zooms, dragging pans, the button calls resetZoom() on the chart.

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) points changed; detail: { x, xLabel, items }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-point-click: A point or a bar was clicked; detail: { x, xLabel, items }
events.minerva-plot-click: The plot area was clicked where there is no point; detail: { x, y } in data coordinates
events.minerva-zoom: The user zoomed or panned; detail: { x, y } (the visible ranges)
events.minerva-renderer-change: The backend is ready, or fell back after a GPU loss; detail: { renderer }

methods.getView: Visible range, null before the engine is created
methods.getRenderer: Backend in use (webgpu, webgl2, webgl, canvas2d), null until ready
